column6: \n///<fName>///,\nThe Qingping region has changed and is no longer a suitable place to live. My spouse and I have decided to retreat to Dali to live in seclusion. If ///<guys||madiam>/// wishes to meet, we would welcome you with open arms. Looking toward the vast sky and sea, we eagerly await your reply.
Yan Nangui's whereabouts have been confirmed. I will return to Cheng'an shortly, and we shall meet at the pavilion as before.\n\nHong Sihai

///<name>///:\nYour wicked deeds are known to all, provoking wrath from both heaven and man. Blood must be repaid with blood. If I find the opportunity, I will personally flay you and break your bones to vent my hatred!

///<name>///:\nI once thought you were formidable, but after witnessing your words and actions, I now realize the Jianghu has someone as conceited and shameless as you—utterly disgraceful and laughable!
///<lName>///:\nThe memories of our past still linger in my heart, impossible to forget. Restless at night, it feels like yesterday. I write this letter to express my deepest feelings.

///<lName>///:\nLong separated, my longing grows daily. I recently obtained something I believe you need, so I send it with this letter. Though a modest gift, it carries my sincere affection—I hope you will accept it.

///<lName>///:\nLately, I have been troubled with no solution in sight. Neither progress in martial arts nor mundane affairs goes smoothly, leaving me anxious and disheartened. I often recall your composed and open-minded approach—if you could reply, it would surely clear my doubts and ease my worries.

///<lName>///:\nThinking of the past, I suddenly miss you. Though I’ve seen many wonders recently, without you by my side, something feels missing. My home awaits—if you are willing, why not come for a visit?

///<name>///:\nEvery time I recall your words and deeds, my heart stirs uncontrollably. I long to follow by your side. If fate allows us to meet again in the Jianghu, I hope to hear your wisdom and learn from you.

///<name>///:\nLong have I admired your reputation, and now, seeing you in person, I find it well-deserved—like gazing upon a towering mountain. Your grace and brilliance leave me in awe and deep respect.
///<name>///:\nYour recent actions can hardly be called honorable. I hope it was unintentional, for then it might be forgiven. But if you persist without remorse, do not blame me for taking action!
///<name>///:\nI have long revered your noble character, sharp mind, and unblemished virtue—like stars adorning the sky, leaving me endlessly captivated...

///<name>///:
Day and night, thoughts of you haunt my dreams—my feelings are beyond restraint. I wish to wander rivers and lakes with you, traverse deserts under lone smoke. At dawn, watch the breeze dance with swords; at night, listen to the rain strum the zither—together in this life...
